subject: general
question: The Indian Antarctic Bill, 2022 belongs to ______ Ministry of India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Earth Sciences.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The correct option is Earth Sciences.**
 
• **The Indian Antarctic Bill, 2022 is legislation related to the activities of the Indian Antarctic Program, which is under the purview of the Ministry of Earth Sciences.**
 
• The Ministry of Earth Sciences is responsible for providing services related to** weather, climate, ocean, and coastal states, as well as for exploration and research in polar regions.**
 
• The bill also aims to give effect to the Antarctic Treaty, the Convention on the Conservation of Antarctic Marine Living Resources, and the Protocol on Environmental Protection to the Antarctic Treaty.
 
• The Indian Antarctic Bill, 2022 introduced in Lok Sabha aims at providing national measures to protect the Antarctic environment and the dependent and associated ecosystems.
 
• Indian Antarctic Bill will also be useful in building credibility and enhancing the status of the country globally.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• The Ministry of Law and Justice is responsible for formulating and implementing laws and policies related to the legal system in India.
 
• The Ministry of External Affairs is responsible for managing India's foreign relations and diplomacy.
 
• The Ministry of Tribal Affairs is responsible for the welfare and development of tribal communities in India.
 
• Hence, the statement "The Indian Antarctic Bill, 2022 belongs to the Ministry of India" is correct and the correct option is Earth Sciences.
